titleEn: The Glory of Kings — David Greets Zion and Prays to Her (ch. 54)
part: ch. 54 — David Greets Zion and Prays to Her
about: The king comes in before the Ark, bows, and prays: God lifts the poor and tests hearts, so may Zion be a savior in every place and for every creature, lead her people, and rise against their enemies. Then he circles her and praises her as a bride. The narrator says the spirit of prophecy was on him, as on Peter and John at Tabor.

sentences.t: ፶፬ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወተሰለማ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 54. where prophesied David and-greeted-her to-Zion
sentences.i: Chapter 54: Where David prophesied and greeted Zion
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፶፬ is 54 (ፄ ፶ = 50, ፬ = 4). ኀበ here opens a title-phrase, 'where / the place in which' (the same word elsewhere is 'with, at'; this reading of the heading is a little loose, ?). ተነበየ is the T-stem of ነበየ, 'prophesied'. ወተሰለማ is ወ- 'and' + ተሰለመ 'greeted, did homage' + the object ሃ 'her', which is then repeated by ለጽዮን 'to Zion' (ለ- marks the person greeted, and doubles the suffix). Zion is the Ark (ታቦት) throughout. 'David' is the throne-name of Menelik, son of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, taken when he was anointed in Jerusalem (see unit 40).

sentences.t: ወቦአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወቆመ ፡ ቅድሜሃ ፡ ወተሰለማ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወይቤ ፤
sentences.l: And-entered king and-stood before-her and-greeted-her and-bowed to-her and-said:
sentences.i: And the king went in and stood before her, and greeted her and bowed down to her, and said:
sentences.n: Narrative verbs in the perfect, each with ወ- 'and': ቦአ 'entered', ቆመ 'stood', ተሰለማ 'greeted her' (ተሰለመ + ሃ, as in the heading), ሰገደ 'bowed down' (ሰገደ ላቲ, with ለ- + the independent form ላቲ 'to her'), ይቤ 'said' (an irregular perfect that regularly introduces speech). ቅድሜሃ 'before her' = ቅድሜ + ሃ. 'Her' is Zion, the Ark, which the king addresses as a person. ፤ marks the pause before the prayer.

sentences.t: እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለከ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ እስመ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ፈቃደከ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ ሰብእ ፤
sentences.l: O-Lord God-of Israel to-you glory for you-do will-your and-not will-of man;
sentences.i: O Lord, God of Israel, to you be glory, for you do your own will and not the will of man.
sentences.n: እግዚኦ is the vocative 'O Lord' (the -ኦ ending); አምላከ እስራኤል is a construct chain, 'God-of Israel' (the final -ä of አምላከ marks the construct). ለከ 'to you' = ለ- + ከ. ስብሐት 'praise, glory' is left without a verb, a wish: 'to you (be) glory'. እስመ 'because, for' begins a reason clause that runs through the next several units. ትገብር is a 2nd-person imperfect (ተ-), 'you do'; ፈቃደከ 'your will' carries the accusative -ä. ወአኮ is 'and not' (አኮ negates a noun or phrase).

sentences.t: ታረስዖ ፡ ጥበቦ ፡ ለጠቢብ ፡ ወታአብዶ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ለመካሪ ፡ ወትሜጥቆ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሠርም ፡ ወታቀውሞን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ለሰኰናሁ ፤
sentences.l: You-bring-to-ruin his-wisdom to-the-wise and-you-make-foolish counsel-of to-the-counselor and-you-lift-out to-the-poor from dung and-you-set-them on rock firm for-his-feet;
sentences.i: You bring the wise man's wisdom to ruin, and make the counselor's counsel foolish, and lift the poor out of the dung and set them on a firm rock for their feet.
sentences.n: A cluster of prophetic echoes: 1 Samuel 2:8 and Psalm 113:7 (the poor raised from the dust and the dunghill), Isaiah 29:14 and 1 Corinthians 1:19-20 (the wisdom of the wise destroyed), Psalm 40:2 (feet set on a rock). Grammar: ታረስዖ ጥበቦ ለጠቢብ, 'you ruin his wisdom, the wise man's' uses an anticipatory suffix (ጥበቦ = ጥበብ + ሁ) followed by ለ- naming the owner, a common Geʿez way of saying 'the wise man's wisdom' (ታረስዖ is a causative of ረስዐ 'be spoiled, rot'; ?). ታአብዶ is the causative 'make foolish'; ምክረ ለመካሪ is the same pattern. ትሜጥቆ 'you draw out, lift' (?, the stem is obscure to me); ሠርም 'dung'. ታቀውሞን 'you set them upright' (ተ- imperfect + ሞን 'them'). ሰኰናሁ is 'his sole/hoof', here 'his feet'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ጽዋዐ ፡ ክብር ፡ ምሉእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፈቅሩከ ፡ ወጽዋዐ ፡ ኀሳርኒ ፡ ምሉእ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይጸልኡ ፡ ኪያከ ፤
sentences.l: For cup-of(acc.) honor full in hand-your to-those they-love-you and-cup-of(acc.) disgrace-also full to-those they-hate you;
sentences.i: For a cup of honor, full, is in your hand for those who love you, and a cup of disgrace, full, for those who hate you.
sentences.n: Cf. Psalm 75:8, the cup in the Lord's hand. ጽዋዐ is ጽዋዕ 'cup' in the accusative (-ä), used because the clause has no verb and the cup is the thing 'set' (ምሉእ 'full' follows). The -ኒ in ኀሳርኒ is the enclitic 'also, and' that the writer will lean on heavily in the next units. ለእለ is ለ- + እለ, 'to those who'; ያፈቅሩከ 'they love you' (አፈቀረ, causative-form verb meaning 'love'); ይጸልኡ ኪያከ 'they hate you' (ኪያ- is the carrier for the object pronoun, ኪያከ 'you').

sentences.t: ወለነሰ ፡ መድኀኒትነ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ እምጽዮን ፡ ወያአትት ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ እምሕዝቡ ፡ ወይትከዐው ፡ ሠናይት ፡ ወምሕረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-as-for-us salvation-our it-goes-out from-Zion and-it-takes-away sin from-people-his and-is-poured-out goodness and-mercy in all world;
sentences.i: But as for us, our salvation goes out from Zion, and takes sin away from his people, and goodness and mercy are poured out over all the world.
sentences.n: Cf. Psalm 14:7 ('salvation of Israel out of Zion') and Isaiah 2:3. ወለነሰ is ወ- + ለነ 'to us' + the particle -ሰ 'but, as for': 'and as for us'. መድኀኒትነ 'our salvation' (መድኀኒት + ነ). The verb ይወፅእ is masculine 'it goes out', the subject being salvation. ያአትት 'removes' (አትተ). ይትከዐው is the passive-reflexive of ከዐወ 'pour out'. Here the people are God's (ሕዝቡ 'his people', ሕዝብ + ሁ). The Kebra's theology: salvation reaches the whole world from Zion, i.e. the Ark.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ንሕነሂ ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊሁንሕነ ፡ መኑ ፡ ይትዔየሮ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አፍቀረነ ፡ ከመ ፡ እስረኤል ፡ ሕዝቦ ፡ ወመኑ ፡ ይግእዞ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አዕረገነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ መንበሩ ፤
sentences.l: For we-also work-of hands-his we who will-reproach-him if he-loved-us like Israel people-his and-who will-restrain-him if he-lifted-us into heavens throne-his;
sentences.i: For we too are the work of his hands. Who will reproach him if he loves us as he loved Israel, his people? And who will hold him back if he raises us up into the heavens, his throne?
sentences.n: The edition prints እደዊሁንሕነ as one word: እደዊሁ 'his hands' + ንሕነ 'we', so 'we are the work of his hands' (ንሕነሂ 'we also' earlier in the clause makes the repeated ንሕነ emphatic). ተግባረ 'work, deed' is in the accusative as a predicate. Two rhetorical questions with መኑ 'who?'; ለእመ 'if'. The verbs are hard: ይትዔየሮ 'will reproach him' (ዐየረ 'blame'; ?) and ይግእዞ 'will hold him back, constrain him' (?, the stem is uncertain; the parallel with the first question guides me). አፍቀረነ 'he loved us' (perfect + object ነ); ከመ እስረኤል is a spelling of 'Israel' (the edition has እስረኤል for እስራኤል). አዕረገነ 'he raised us up' (causative of ዐርገ 'ascend'). Heaven as God's throne: Isaiah 66:1. The point: the Ethiopians are brought into the people of God like Israel.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወሕይወት ፡ እምኀቤሁ ፡ ክብር ፡ ወኀሳር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፤
sentences.l: For death and-life from-with-him honor and-disgrace in hand-his;
sentences.i: For death and life are from him; honor and disgrace are in his hand.
sentences.n: Cf. Deuteronomy 32:39 and 1 Samuel 2:6 ('the Lord kills and makes alive'). እምኀቤሁ is እም- 'from' + ኀበ 'with' + ሁ, literally 'from with him', i.e. 'from him'. The clause has no verb ('are' is understood), a normal Geʿez nominal sentence. ኀሳር 'loss, disgrace, shame'.

sentences.t: ይክል ፡ ቀሢፈ ፡ ወያበዝኅ ፡ ተሣህሎ ፡ ይትመዐዕ ፡ ወያበዝኅ ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈታኔ ፡ ልብ ፡ ወኵልያት ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: He-is-able to-strike and-he-multiplies compassion-his he-is-angry and-he-multiplies mercy-his for tester-of heart and-kidneys he;
sentences.i: He is able to strike, and he multiplies his compassion; he is angry, and he multiplies his mercy; for he is the tester of the heart and of the kidneys.
sentences.n: ይክል ቀሢፈ 'he is able to strike' (ቀሠፈ 'scourge, smite'; the infinitive-like ቀሢፈ in the accusative follows ይክል 'he can', a regular pattern). ተሣህሎ 'his compassion' (ተሣህሎ + ሁ). ይትመዐዕ 'he is angry' (ተመዐ). The point is that his anger is outweighed by mercy: cf. Psalm 103:8-9. ፈታኔ ልብ ወኵልያት, 'tester of heart and kidneys' (ፈታኒ with the construct ending -ኔ), echoes Psalm 7:9, Jeremiah 11:20 and Revelation 2:23; the kidneys (ኵልያት) are the seat of the inmost thoughts.

sentences.t: ይሁብ ፡ ወይነሥእ ፡ ይተክል ፡ ወይምሑ ፡ የሐንጽ ፡ ወይነሥት ፡ ያሤኒ ፡ ወይመቊስ ፤
sentences.l: He-gives and-he-takes he-plants and-he-uproots he-builds and-he-tears-down he-makes-well and-he-wounds;
sentences.i: He gives and he takes; he plants and he uproots; he builds and he tears down; he makes well and he wounds.
sentences.n: A run of paired imperfects, each pair joined by ወ-: ይሁብ / ይነሥእ, ይተክል / ይምሑ, የሐንጽ / ይነሥት. Echoes: Job 1:21, Ecclesiastes 3:2-3, Jeremiah 1:10, Job 5:18 ('he wounds and he binds up'). ይምሑ 'he wipes out, uproots' (መሐወ). ያሤኒ 'he makes good/well' (causative of ሠነየ) and ይመቊስ 'he wounds' (?, the verb is not found in my usual lists; I follow the pairing with Job 5:18 and Deuteronomy 32:39).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ እምኀቤሁ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ኮነ ።
sentences.l: For all to-him and-all from-with-him and-all in-him it-was.
sentences.i: For everything is his, and everything is from him, and everything came to be through him.
sentences.n: ሎቱ 'to him, his' (ለ- + ቱ in its fused form), እምኀቤሁ 'from him' (as in unit 7), ቦቱ 'in him, by him'. Cf. Romans 11:36 ('from him and through him and to him are all things') and John 1:3 ('all things came to be through him'). ኮነ is the perfect of ኮነ 'be, come to be'. ። closes the king's praise to God; what follows is the king's direct address to the Ark.

sentences.t: ወአንቲኒ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተሐውሪ ፡ ወእምኀበኒ ፡ ወፃእኪ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-also Ark-of law-his of-God savior be(f.) where you-go and-from-where-also you-went-out;
sentences.i: And you also, Ark of the law of God, be a savior wherever you go and from wherever you have gone out.
sentences.n: Now Zion is addressed in the feminine. ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'Ark-of law-his, of God': ሕጉ is ሕግ + ሁ, with ለእግዚኣብሔር naming the owner (anticipatory suffix, as in unit 3), so 'the Ark of the law of God'. ወአንቲኒ is ወ- + አንቲ 'you (f.)' + ኒ 'also'. ኩኒ is the feminine imperative of ኮነ 'be'; it is the refrain of the whole litany. መድኀኒተ is the accusative of መድኀኒት 'savior', here a predicate: 'be a savior'. ኀበ ተሐውሪ 'where you walk' (ተሐውሪ, 2nd person feminine imperfect subjunctive of ሐወረ 'go'). ወእምኀበኒ ወፃእኪ 'and from wherever you went out' (ፃእኪ is the perfect 2nd feminine of ወፅአ 'go out'; the reading of -ኒ as 'ever' is mine).

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በቤትኒ ፡ ወበገዳምኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-house-also and-in-wilderness-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior in the house and in the wilderness.
sentences.n: The start of a long litany that repeats መድኀኒተ ኩኒ 'be a savior' before each pair of places or persons. The enclitic -ኒ is attached to each member, giving 'both ... and ...' (or 'in house and also in wilderness'); I translate it only as 'and' to keep the English plain. በ- 'in'. The pairs move from the home outward (house, wilderness), then sea and land, mountains, heaven and earth, death and life, and then to the people.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በዝየኒ ፡ ወበከሐክኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-here-also and-in-parched-land-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior here and in the dry land (?).
sentences.n: ዝየ is 'here'. ከሐክ is uncertain: I take it as a word for dry, parched ground (?) so as to balance 'here'; Dillmann's lists gave me nothing firm. The pair may mean 'near and far'; treat the rendering as a guess.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በታዕካኒ ፡ ወበፅሙናኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-cave-also and-in-solitude-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior in the cave (?) and in the solitary places (?).
sentences.n: ታዕካ is read here as 'cave, hollow' (?, uncertain). ፅሙና is related to ጸመወ 'be silent, desolate', so 'desolate place, solitude, wasteland' (?). Both readings are tentative; the pair evidently names the wild and out-of-the-way places.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በባሕርኒ ፡ ወበየብስኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-sea-also and-in-dry-land-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior on the sea and on the dry land.
sentences.n: ባሕር 'sea' and የብስ 'dry land' (the Genesis 1:9-10 pair). በ- here is 'on' or 'in'.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በአድባርኒ ፡ ወበአውግርኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-mountains-also and-in-hills-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior in the mountains and in the hills (?).
sentences.n: አድባር is the plural of ደብር 'mountain' (the same word as in ደብረ ታቦር, Mount Tabor, in unit 40). አውግር 'hills' (?); the plural is an irregular pattern I cannot confirm in Dillmann.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በሰማያትኒወበምድርኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-heavens-also-and-in-earth-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior in the heavens and on the earth.
sentences.n: The edition prints በሰማያትኒወበምድርኒ with no wordspace between -ኒ and ወ-; read በሰማያትኒ ወበምድርኒ. The text is kept as the edition has it. ሰማያት is the plural 'heavens'.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በምጽናዓትኒ ፡ ወበቀላያት ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-strongholds-also and-in-depths;
sentences.i: Be a savior in the high places (?) and in the depths.
sentences.n: ምጽናዓት is unclear (?): ጸንዐ means 'be firm', so 'strongholds, firm places' or, set against ቀላይ 'deep, the abyss', perhaps 'heights'. ቀላያት is the plural of ቀላይ 'deep waters'. Note that the second member has no -ኒ here.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በሞትኒ ፡ ወበሕይወትኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-death-also and-in-life-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior in death and in life.
sentences.n: Compare unit 7 (death and life are from him) and Romans 14:8. ሞት 'death', ሕይወት 'life'.

sentences.t: መድ ፡ ኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ በበአትኪ ፡ ወበፀአትኪ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) in-your-entering and-in-your-going-out;
sentences.i: Be a savior at your coming in and your going out.
sentences.n: The edition splits the first word with a wordspace (መድ ፡ ኀኒተ for መድኀኒተ); the text is kept as the edition has it. በአትኪ 'your entering' (ቦአት, a verbal noun of ቦአ 'enter', + ኪ 'your (f.)') and ፀአትኪ 'your going out' (ፀአት, of ወፅአ). Cf. Psalm 121:8 and Deuteronomy 28:6 ('blessed in your coming in and going out').

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለደቂቅነሂ ፡ ወለነገደ ፡ ሕዝብኪ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for-children-our-also and-for-tribes-of people-your;
sentences.i: Be a savior for our children and for the tribes of your people.
sentences.n: ለደቂቅነሂ is ለ- + ደቂቅ 'children' + ነ 'our' + ሂ 'also' (a variant of the -ኒ enclitic). ነገደ ሕዝብኪ is a construct chain, 'tribes-of people-your' (ነገድ 'tribe, kind'). ለ- here marks those who benefit ('for').

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለበሓውርትኒ ፡ ወለአህጉርኒ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for-regions-our-also and-for-cities-also;
sentences.i: Be a savior for our lands (?) and for our cities.
sentences.n: በሓውርት is read as 'regions, lands' (?). አህጉር is the plural of ሀገር 'city, town'. The 'our' in my translation is supplied from the context (?); the Geʿez has no pronoun here.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለነገሥት ፡ ወለመኳንንት ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for kings and-for governors;
sentences.i: Be a savior for kings and for rulers.
sentences.n: ነገሥት is the plural of ንጉሥ 'king'; መኳንንት is the plural of መኰንን 'governor, noble, judge'.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለአትክልት ፡ ወለፍረያት ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for plants and-for fruits;
sentences.i: Be a savior for the plants and for the fruits.
sentences.n: አትክልት 'plants, crops' (from ተከለ 'plant'; cf. ይተክል in unit 9) and ፍረያት 'fruits', plural of ፍሬ.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለሰብእኒ ፡ ወለእንስሳ ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for-man-also and-for-cattle;
sentences.i: Be a savior for people and for cattle.
sentences.n: ሰብእ 'man, human beings'; እንስሳ 'domestic animals, cattle'. The order moves from the produce of the earth to living things, as in Genesis 1.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለአዕዋፍኒ ፡ ወለአራዊት ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for-birds-also and-for-wild-beasts;
sentences.i: Be a savior for the birds and for the wild beasts.
sentences.n: አዕዋፍ 'birds' (plural of ዖፍ) and አራዊት 'wild beasts' (plural of አርዌ).

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ለሐመልማልኒ ፡ ወለጽገያት ፤
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) for-herbage-also and-for-flowers;
sentences.i: Be a savior for the green herbage and for the flowers.
sentences.n: ሐመልማል 'green herbage, grass'; ጽገያት is the plural of ጽጌ 'flower'. The litany ends with the plants, mirroring its start in the house.

sentences.t: መድኀኒተ ፡ ኩኒ ፡ ጸልዪ ፡ ወመሐሪ ፡ መሐኪ ፡ ሕዝበኪ ።
sentences.l: Savior be(f.) intercede(f.) and-merciful have-mercy(f.) people-your.
sentences.i: Be a savior: intercede, be merciful, and have mercy on your people.
sentences.n: The litany ends. ጸልዪ is the feminine imperative of ጸለየ, 'pray, intercede' (?); ወመሐሪ is 'and merciful (one)' (?, either the noun 'merciful' or a spelling of the imperative ምሕሪ); መሐኪ is the feminine imperative of መሐረ 'have mercy'. The first reading of ጸልዪ is uncertain; 'hear' (?) would also suit. ሕዝበኪ is the accusative ሕዝብ + ኪ 'your people'.

sentences.t: ኩንነ ፡ ጥቅመ ፡ ወንከውነኪ ፡ ሐጹረ ፤
sentences.l: Be(f.)-to-us help and-we-shall-be-to-you wall;
sentences.i: Be a help to us, and we shall be a wall around you.
sentences.n: ኩንነ is the feminine imperative of ኮነ with ነ 'to us'. ጥቅመ is the accusative of ጥቅም 'help, advantage'; ሐጹረ is ሐጹር 'wall, rampart'. ንከውነኪ is the 1st plural jussive-future 'we shall be' with ኪ 'to you'; ወ- + the subjunctive here gives 'so that we shall be'. Cf. Zechariah 2:5.

sentences.t: ንገሢ ፡ ለነ ፡ ወንከውነኪ ፡ ሕዝበ ፤
sentences.l: Reign(f.) over-us and-we-shall-be-to-you people;
sentences.i: Reign over us, and we shall be your people.
sentences.n: ንገሢ is the feminine imperative of ነግሠ 'reign'; the ለ- on ለነ gives 'over us' (a regular dative with ነግሠ). ሕዝበ is the accusative of ሕዝብ. The thought echoes Jeremiah 7:23 and the Old Testament covenant formula 'I shall be your God and you shall be my people'.

sentences.t: ኩንነ ፡ መርሐ ፡ ወንተሉ ፡ ድኅሬኪ ፤
sentences.l: Be(f.)-to-us guide and-we-shall-follow behind-you;
sentences.i: Be a guide to us, and we shall follow behind you.
sentences.n: መርሐ is መርሕ 'leader, guide' (accusative predicate). ንተሉ is the 1st plural subjunctive of ተልወ 'follow'. ድኅሬኪ 'behind you, after you' (ድኅሬ + ኪ). The Ark leads the way, as in Numbers 10:33-36.

sentences.t: ኢትትአንተሊ ፡ ወኢትትሀየዪ ፡ ወኢትትቈጥዒ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ አበሳነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ዘኢተምህረ ፡ ሰብሖተኪ ፤
sentences.l: Not-be-dismayed(?) and-not-be-slack(?) and-not-be-angry at-multitude-of sins-our for we people who-not-have law who-not-was-taught praises-your;
sentences.i: Do not be dismayed (?), or slack (?), or angry at the multitude of our sins, for we are a people without law, who have not learned your praises.
sentences.n: A string of three negative commands (ኢ- + the feminine 2nd person imperfect). ኢትትአንተሊ and ኢትትሀየዪ are uncertain (?): the stems are reflexive and I can't confirm them in Dillmann; ተሀየየ is possibly 'be slack, negligent' and the first something like 'be wearied, dismayed'. ኢትትቈጥዒ is from ተቈጥዐ 'be angry' (ቍጥዓ 'anger'). በብዝኀ is በ- + ብዝኀ (construct) 'in the multitude of'. ዘአልቦ ሕገ 'who has no law': ዘ- 'who' + አልቦ 'there is not to him' (a common idiom). ዘኢተምህረ 'who has not learned' (ተምህረ, the passive/reflexive of መሀረ 'teach'); the people addressed are the Ethiopians, who were not given the Law as Israel was. ሰብሖተኪ 'your praises'.

sentences.t: ወእምይእዜሰ ፡ ምርሐነ ፡ ወመሀረነ ፡ ወአለብወነ ፡ ወአጥብበነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንትመሀር ፡ ሰብሖተኪ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ይሰባሕ ፡ ስምኪ ፡ በላዕሌነ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዐልት ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ሌሊት ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ሰዐት ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ኑኀ ፡ አዝማን ፤
sentences.l: And-from-now-indeed guide-us and-teach-us and-give-us-understanding and-make-us-wise that we-may-learn praises-your and-that it-may-be-praised name-your over-us in-all time and-in-all days in-all day and-in-all night in-all hour and-in-all length-of times;
sentences.i: And from now on, guide us and teach us, give us understanding and make us wise, so that we may learn your praises, and so that your name may be praised among us at every time and on all days, in every day and every night, in every hour and through all the length of the ages.
sentences.n: ወእምይእዜሰ is ወ- + እም- 'from' + ይእዜ 'now' + -ሰ 'indeed, then'. Four imperatives with ነ 'us': ምርሐነ (of መርሐ 'lead'), መሀረነ ('teach'), ወአለብወነ (causative of ለበወ, 'make understand', ልብ 'mind'), ወአጥብበነ (causative of ጠበበ, 'make wise'; ጥበብ 'wisdom'). ከመ 'so that' takes the subjunctive ንትመሀር 'we may learn' and the passive ይሰባሕ 'may be praised' (ስምኪ 'your name'). በላዕሌነ 'upon us' (ላዕለ + ነ). The long list of time words (ጊዜ, መዋዕል 'days', መዐልት 'day', ሌሊት 'night', ሰዐት 'hour') ends with ኑኀ አዝማን, 'length of times' (ኑኀ is the construct of ኑኅ 'length'), i.e. forever.

sentences.t: ሀብነ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ንትቀነይ ፡ ለኪ ፤
sentences.l: Give-us strength that-we-may-serve to-you;
sentences.i: Give us strength to serve you.
sentences.n: ሀብነ is the imperative of ወሀበ 'give' with ነ 'us' (note the shortened imperative). ንትቀነይ is the 1st plural subjunctive of ተቀነየ 'serve' (a reflexive T-stem), with ለኪ 'to you', the object marked by ለ-. ኀይል 'strength'.

sentences.t: ተንሥኢ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወልበሲ ፡ ኀይለኪ ፡ ወሙኢዮሙ ፡ ለጸላእትኪ ፡ ወ ፡ ሀብነ ፡ ጽንዐ ፡ ለነገሥትኪ ፡ ወአስተኀፍርዮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይጸልኡ ፡ ኪያኪ ፡ ወአስተፈሥሒዮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፈቅሩኪ ፨
sentences.l: Arise(f.) Zion and-put-on(f.) strength-your and-conquer-them(f.) over-enemies-your and give-us firmness for-kings-your and-make-ashamed(f.)-them those they-hate you and-make-glad(f.)-them those they-love you.
sentences.i: Arise, Zion, and put on your strength, and overcome your enemies, and give us firmness for your kings (?). Put to shame those who hate you, and make glad those who love you.
sentences.n: Cf. Isaiah 52:1 ('Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion') and Psalm 132:8 ('Arise, Lord, into your resting place, you and the ark of your strength'). Four feminine imperatives: ተንሥኢ ('arise'), ልበሲ ('put on'), ሙኢዮሙ ('overcome them', ሞአ with ዮሙ 'them'), አስተኀፍርዮሙ and አስተፈሥሒዮሙ (causatives 'shame' and 'gladden', each with ዮሙ). The edition has a stray wordspace in ወ ፡ ሀብነ; the text is kept as given. ሀብነ ጽንዐ ለነገሥትኪ is awkward (?): literally 'give-us firmness to-your-kings'; the ነ may be a stray, in which case 'give your kings firmness'. I read it as above. The ፨ marks the end of the prayer.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ዖዳ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ነያ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ነያ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ነያ ፡ መስተፈሥሒት ፡ ነያ ፡ ብርህት ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ነያ ፡ ስርጉት ፡ በስብሐት ፡ ነያ ፡ ስርጉት ፡ ከመ ፡ መርዓት ፡ አኮ ፡ በአልባሰ ፡ ክብር ፡ ኀላፊ ፡ አላ ፡ ስርጉት ፡ በክብር ፡ ወበስብሐት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-then he-went-around-her and-said: Behold-her Zion behold-her savior behold-her giver-of-joy behold-her shining like sun behold-her adorned in-glory behold-her adorned like bride not in-garments-of glory passing but adorned in-glory and-in-praise from-with God;
sentences.i: Then he went around her and said: Here is Zion! Here is the savior! Here is she who gives joy! Here is she who shines like the sun! Here is she who is adorned with glory! Here is she who is adorned like a bride, not in garments of passing glory, but adorned with glory and splendor from God.
sentences.n: ዖዳ is ዖደ 'go around, encircle' + ሃ 'her' (reading mine; he circles the Ark as David danced before it in 2 Samuel 6:14). ነያ is 'behold her' (an interjection built on the 3rd feminine ending, repeated for emphasis). The adjectives are feminine: መስተፈሥሒት 'she who gives joy' (a participle of the causative-reflexive ተፈሥሐ), ብርህት 'bright, shining', ስርጉት 'adorned'. Cf. Song of Songs 6:10 ('bright as the sun') and Isaiah 61:10, Revelation 21:2 (a bride adorned). አኮ በአልባሰ ክብር ኀላፊ: አልባሰ is the construct of አልባስ 'garments', ክብር 'glory, honor', ኀላፊ 'passing, transient'; the garments are of the earthly kind and the glory is from God. አላ 'but'. ስብሐት 'praise, splendor'.

sentences.t: እንተ ፡ ይኔጽሩ ፡ መፍትው ፡ ወአኮ ፡ እንተ ፡ የኀድጉ ፡ እንተ ፡ ያበድሩ ፡ መፍትው ፡ ወአኮ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይሜንኑ ፡ እንተ ፡ ያፈቅሩ ፡ መፍትው ፡ ወአኮ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይጸልኡ ፡ እንተይቀርቡ ፡ መፍትው ፡ ወአኮ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይርሕቁ ፤
sentences.l: Which(f.) they-look worthy and-not which(f.) they-leave which(f.) they-esteem(?) worthy and-not which(f.) they-despise which(f.) they-love worthy and-not which(f.) they-hate which(f.)-they-approach worthy and-not which(f.) they-keep-far;
sentences.i: She whom they look upon is worthy, and not she whom they forsake; she whom they esteem (?) is worthy, and not she whom they despise; she whom they love is worthy, and not she whom they hate; she whom they draw near to is worthy, and not she whom they keep far away.
sentences.n: A very difficult passage (?). እንተ is the feminine relative 'she who, that which'; with the plural verb it must be 'she whom (they look at)', Zion being the antecedent. Alternatively 'that which' would give 'what they look upon is worthy'. መፍትው 'fitting, worthy'. The verbs: ይኔጽሩ 'they look' (ነጸረ), የኀድጉ 'they leave' (ኀደገ), ያበድሩ (?, perhaps 'they esteem, favor'; I cannot confirm the root), ይሜንኑ 'they despise, renounce' (መነነ), ያፈቅሩ 'love', ይጸልኡ 'hate', ይቀርቡ 'draw near' (እንተይቀርቡ is run together in the edition), ይርሕቁ 'are far'. The four pairs set love against hatred and nearness against distance. I take the sense to be that Zion is worthy of the people's love and nearness; the detail is uncertain.

sentences.t: ንቀርበኪ ፡ ወኢትርሐቅነ ፡ ንትመረጐዘኪ ፡ ወኢታድኅፅነ ፡ ንስእለኪ ፡ ወኢትጸመምነ ፡ ንጸርኅ ፡ ኀቤኪ ፡ ወስምዒ ፡ ገዓረነ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘሰአልነ ፡ ኀቤኪ ፡ ወኢትፍቅዲ ፡ ተግሕሦ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ እግዚእኪ ፡ ወይነግሥ ፡ ላዕሌኪ ፤
sentences.l: We-approach-you and-not-go-far-from-us we-lean-on-you and-not-leave(?)-us we-ask-you and-not-be-deaf-to-us we-cry to-you and-hear(f.) cry-our in all which we-asked of-you and-not-wish(f.) turning-away from-us until he-comes Lord-your and-reigns over-you;
sentences.i: Let us draw near to you, and do not go far from us; let us lean on you, and do not abandon us (?); let us ask you, and do not turn a deaf ear to us; let us cry to you, and hear our cry in all that we asked of you, and do not choose to turn away from us until your Lord comes and reigns over you.
sentences.n: Pairs of 1st-person plural subjunctives (the 'let us' form: ንቀርበኪ, ንትመረጐዘኪ, ንስእለኪ, ንጸርኅ) set against feminine negative commands (ኢትርሐቅነ, ኢታድኅፅነ, ኢትጸመምነ, ኢትፍቅዲ). ንትመረጐዘኪ is from ተመርጐዘ 'lean upon' (መርጎዝ 'staff'). ኢታድኅፅነ is uncertain (?): I read 'do not abandon us'. ኢትጸመምነ is of ጸመመ 'be deaf, mute'. ስምዒ 'hear!' (feminine imperative of ሰምዐ), ገዓረነ 'our cry' (ገዓር + ነ, accusative). ተግሕሦ is read as 'turning away' (?). እስከ ይመጽእ እግዚእኪ ወይነግሥ ላዕሌኪ: the Lord (here God, or the Messiah) 'comes and reigns over you', an expectation of the Lord's coming to Zion; cf. Zechariah 14:9.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ አንቲ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ሰማይ ።
sentences.l: For dwelling-his you for-God-of heaven.
sentences.i: For you are the dwelling of the God of heaven.
sentences.n: ማኅደሩ አንቲ ለአምላከ ሰማይ: ማኅደሩ is ማኅደር 'dwelling' + ሁ 'his', again an anticipatory suffix with ለ- giving the owner, so 'you are his dwelling, the God of heaven's'. አምላከ ሰማይ is a construct chain, 'God-of heaven'. The Ark is God's dwelling-place on earth, the central theology of the book.

sentences.t: ዘንተ ፡ ተናገረ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡ ወረደ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ትንቢት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍሥሓሁ ፡ ወኢያአምር ፡ ዘይነብብ ፡ በከመ ፡ ጴጥሮስ ፡ ወዮሐንስ ፡ በርእሰ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ታቦር ፤
sentences.l: This he-spoke David king son-of Solomon king-of Israel for it-came-down upon-him spirit-of prophecy because-of joy-his and-not-he-knew what he-says like Peter and-John on-top-of mountain-of Tabor;
sentences.i: David the king, the son of Solomon, king of Israel, spoke this, for the spirit of prophecy came down on him because of his joy, and he did not know what he was saying, as Peter and John did on the top of Mount Tabor.
sentences.n: The narrator steps in. ዘንተ is the accusative of ዝንቱ 'this'. ዳዊት ንጉሥ ወልደ ሰሎሞን ንጉሠ እስራኤል: 'David king, son of Solomon, king of Israel' (ንጉሠ is the construct of ንጉሥ before እስራኤል). This is Menelik under his throne-name. መንፈሰ ትንቢት 'spirit of prophecy' (construct, 'spirit-of prophecy'). ኢያአምር 'he did not know' (the imperfect used as a past 'did not know'). ዘይነብብ 'what he says' (ነበበ). The comparison is to Peter and John (the text names two; the Gospels name Peter, James and John) at the Transfiguration, when Peter did not know what he said (Luke 9:33). ደብረ ታቦር is Mount Tabor, the traditional site of the Transfiguration.

sentences.t: ወአንከርዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነቢያትኑ ፡ ኍሉቅ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-marveled-at-him all-of-them and-said this son-of prophet among prophets-? counted
sentences.i: And they all marveled at him and said, 'This is a prophet's son. Is he counted among the prophets?'
sentences.n: Cf. 1 Samuel 10:11-12 and 19:24, where the onlookers ask 'Is Saul also among the prophets?' ወአንከርዎ is አንከረ 'marvel at' + ዎ 'him' (the causative stem, which with the object means 'be amazed by'). ኵሎሙ 'all of them'. ወይቤሉ 'and they said'. ውስተ ነቢያትኑ: ኑ is the question enclitic 'is it so?' (here 'among the prophets?'). ኍሉቅ is 'counted' (the passive participle of ኈለቈ 'count'). The edition ends with a double ፨ ፨, the closing marker of the section; it is kept as part of the last unit.
